description: This file declares the RemoteRemotelyProvisionedComponent class, which implements the BnRemotelyProvisionedComponent interface for remote key provisioning in Android's security keymint framework. It includes method declarations for generating keys and certificate requests, and references external keymaster implementation.

classes.name: RemoteRemotelyProvisionedComponent
classes.description: Implementation of the BnRemotelyProvisionedComponent interface for remote key provisioning, encapsulating a reference to a RemoteKeymaster instance and providing methods for key and certificate request generation.

methods.name: RemoteRemotelyProvisionedComponent
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the component with a reference to a RemoteKeymaster implementation.

methods.name: getHardwareInfo
methods.description: Retrieves hardware information related to the remote component.

methods.name: generateEcdsaP256KeyPair
methods.description: Generates an ECDSA P-256 key pair, optionally in test mode, and outputs the public key and private key handle.

methods.name: generateCertificateRequest
methods.description: Creates a certificate signing request based on provided keys, challenge, and device info.

methods.name: generateCertificateRequestV2
methods.description: Creates a version 2 certificate signing request with specified keys and challenge.
